source_methodology.direct_exchange_payloads: Exact JSON text surfaced by public REST endpoints and retained below; response headers and raw HTTP wire bytes were not exposed by the retrieval interface.
source_methodology.secondary_page_capture: Normalized, explicitly bounded text excerpts retained with SHA-256; exact page retrieval timestamps were not exposed, so the run reference time is not represented as a provider timestamp.
source_methodology.timestamp_policy: Provider event time, publisher update time, data-as-of time and retrieval reference time remain separate.
source_methodology.independence_policy: Distinct publishers are not presumed independent where they consume the same exchange or issuer files. Independence groups below identify the underlying source family.

kraken.bid_ask_size_fields: Kraken raw ticker fields retained; not normalized into XRP size because API lot-volume semantics were not independently verified.

direct_market_metrics.cross_venue_gap_interpretation: Raw Kraken USD and OKX USDT quotes are not normalized for USD/USDT basis, timestamps, fees, transfer constraints or slippage; not an arbitrage signal.

orderbook_depth.retrieval_result: Depth endpoints were inaccessible through this browser retrieval path. The Barrot scheduled collector already defines Kraken, OKX, Coinbase, Binance, Bybit and Bitbank depth endpoints, but scheduled collection is not yet running on main.

secondary_observations.excerpt: As of 2026-11-08T08:00:00Z, 22.34B XRP in 701 XRPL wallets attributed to 24 exchanges; same-wallet change -104.4M XRP (-0.47%) over Nov 1-Nov 8 and -149.3M XRP (-0.68%) over Oct 9-Nov 8. Includes cold storage; Coinbase total includes 151.3M cbXRP reserve; Binance total includes 327.4M Binance-Peg reserve; new-wallet coverage changes make naive total change +362.7M and not a same-wallet flow. Wallet balances are not tradable float and cannot identify customer ownership or sale intent.
limitations: Cold storage included.
Wallet labels are XRPSCAN/public attribution, not proof of beneficial ownership.
Same-wallet change cannot distinguish customer withdrawals from internal wallet migration or unlabeled destinations.
Not tradable float; reserves for cbXRP and Binance-Peg XRP are included.
New wallet coverage can make naive total changes misleading.

Different mark/index pricing and aggregation timing.
Different treatment of cross-margin, coin-margined or non-perpetual contracts.
